purpose: Bounded mechanism attribution,not a new-thesis admission or production promotion
novelty_gate: CPU generic copy propagation exactly matches Tail on all tested plans;no unique assignment-elimination novelty established. GPU study separates engineering,planning and execution;A requires an independently defensible nonincremental difference,not speed alone.
host: One selected SM120 GPU after CPU replacement;2xXeon Platinum8575C;GPU-local NUMA placement
isolation: One advisory GPU/campaign lock;two-sided owned PID/starttime observer;idle before and after each target;no clocks/power/process changes;first failure stops,no automatic retry
sources: Fresh snapshot from parent commit plus this task's named files;all source,generated source,input,binary and oracle hashes frozen in registration/ready before targets

data.query: B1 inclusive exact range;radius0.705625057220459;frozen32 query IDs
data.incoming: Identical parent W2 incoming vectors,fresh monotone occurrence IDs

executor: Official installed CCCL Thrust for_each_n with cuda::par_nosync indexed bit-copy;default native launch policy,no new dependency. Same functor/binary in generic-wave,generic-DSE and Tail-generic paths. Tail-custom uses frozen one128-thread CTA per final row. This is an explicit strong standard-library comparator,not an oracle over all GPU executors.
planner: Generic arbitrary-copy original-source propagation versus frozen descending-tail provenance;both sort final assignments by destination and charge a common in-place nonalias certificate. Wave paths retain all native moves and respect physical RAW/WAW levels.
semantics: Ordered logical occurrences;full allocated capacity including retired rows;full maps,next ID and mutation witnesses;unchanged append/query visibility and native fields;no indirect layout,tombstones,concurrency or Graph

workloads.limitation: Synthetic logical-age cancellation/recency stress,not real application traces. Timing uncertainty is process-conditional on one fixed trace per family,not across workload realizations. W2 is the unchanged negative control,never averaged away.
workloads.mixed_query_windows: 0,50000,200000,350000,500000 replacements;32 queries per window;8 warmups excluded
workloads.micro_query_windows: 0,2048,4096,6144,8192 replacements;queries separately excluded from per-update ACKs

timing.ACK: Full validation,owner/provenance planning,metadata,H2D/D2D/library dispatch,wait,bookkeeping and local destructor costs included
timing.replacement: Outer delete+insert interval including common client operation-ledger work;diagnostic qualification callbacks contaminate only diagnostic timings,never main measurements
timing.service: Formal160 queries plus updates and client loop,then release;denominator events+release
timing.separate_exclusions: Initial disk input/build,8 warmups,offline full-state/query exports between events and release;identical for all variants
timing.qualification: Diagnostic2 additionally checks every changed allocated row after every ACK and exact internal FP64 hit scores;these diagnostic times are not primary evidence
timing.planning_subtimer: Owner/move capture and plan construction/certificate;destructors included only in whole ACK,not construction subtimer

quality: All targets complete members/IDs/native rounded-square bits;native distance squared scaled-error<=5e-5 unchanged;diag2 original-order FP64 hit bits;independent all-eight-field mutation replay and final maps;complete allocated GPU capacity byte comparison;fixed stale mean and query-stage ledger
gates: Query SASS function hashes unchanged;compile/resources distinct from runtime
Bounded4096 and full1M qualification on all4 traces;microB1/32/512 qualification
6 fresh processes per fixed primary cell with forward/reverse order
NSYS activities for W2 and RECENT4;NCU first matching indexed-copy/custom update kernel only

statistics.primary: Median of6 process means;report all raw values,p10/p90 and sample regressions
statistics.paired: Candidate/comparator paired geometric mean ratio;fixed seed2026101705,20000 process-pair bootstrap95% CI;process wins and forward/reverse split
statistics.aggregation: No single pooled average across dependency classes;service and update ACK denominators separate
statistics.interpretation: CI below1 supports a conditional same-trace win,not novelty.10% service and20% delete are attractive goals,not automatic kill/admission thresholds

memory_and_traffic: 4096B explicit update device scratch when allocated. Host RSS includes shared client inputs/plans;isolated plan peak UNKNOWN unless independently measured. Ledger payload is destination-write request bytes,not total DRAM;metadata separate. NSYS actual activities/durations distinct from logical counts. NCU one selected kernel is diagnostic only;whole-service DRAM/L2 UNKNOWN.
stop: First source,build,isolation,runtime,sanitizer or correctness failure:retain all valid/failed/unexecuted records and stop. No silent rerun,replacement,threshold relaxation or budget increase.
classification: Report plan A-E with separate structural,engineering and novelty judgments. Missing gates INCONCLUSIVE;generic-equivalent plans forbid exclusive algorithm novelty;negative structural evidence does not negate engineering value. No automatic paper editing or production dispatch change.
public_curation: Only deployment label/ordinal/NUMA identifiers redacted;all workload,quality,timing,statistics and budget fields unchanged
